english.title: Fraudulently load an aircraft before customs clearance made
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AIRCRAFT..), having been required to obtain clearance from a customs and excise airport at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) under section 64 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 and goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), having been

(A)_[loaded]_
(B)_[made waterborne for loading]_

with fraudulent intent into that aircraft at that airport before application for clearance was made, you were concerned therein with knowledge of that intent
english.legislation: Contrary to section 64(7) and (8) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
aircraft having been required to obtain clearance
from a customs and excise airport
under s. 64 Customs and Excise Management Act 1979
goods having been loaded / made waterborne for loading
with fraudulent intent
into that aircraft at that airport
before application for clearance was made
were concerned therein with knowledge of that intent

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This section was amended by Schedule 7 to the Taxation (Cross Border Trade) Act 2020, brought into force on the 31st December 2020 by SI 2020/1642. For any offences committed on or after the 31st December 2020, see offence document H100137 (CJS code CE79358).

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding £20,000 or of three times the value of the goods whichever is the greater.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex

libra.complexpenaltydetails: On summary conviction the maximum financial penalty is £20,000 or of three times the value of the goods whichever is the greater
